text:
Harborview Apartments Larkspur Bay

Located 300 m from Larkspur Bay Beach, Harborview Apartments offers air-conditioned accommodation with a balcony and free WiFi. The apartment features 1 bedroom, a living room with a sofa bed, and a kitchen with a dishwasher and an oven. Guests can enjoy the sea view from the terrace.

Property highlights
Perfect for a 4-night stay!
Top location: highly rated by recent guests (9.1)

Most popular facilities
Free WiFi
Non-smoking rooms
Air conditioning
Balcony
Free parking

Prices
Apartment with Sea View: US$128 per night
Taxes and charges: US$19

House rules
Check-in: From 14:00 to 20:00
Check-out: Until 10:00
Cancellation/prepayment: Policies vary according to apartment type.
Children & beds: Children of all ages are welcome.
Maximum occupancy: 4 guests
Pets: Pets are not allowed.
Parties: Parties/events are not allowed.
Quiet hours: Guests must be quiet between 22:00 and 08:00.
